blind.description: A freestanding vintage birdcage mounted on a wooden pedestal base. The upper section consists of a cylindrical brass-colored cage with vertical bars, a domed top with an ornamental ring finial, a small latching door on one side, and a horizontal wooden perch inside. The lower section is a turned dark-wood pedestal resting on a three-legged tripod base that sits directly on the ground. All surfaces are clean, smooth, and geometrically well-defined with no disconnected or broken elements.
blind.from_above: A circular array of radiating brass bars converging on a central decorative loop finial, resembling a spoke wheel or circular grille.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 to 5.0 feet tall (reaching roughly to the shoulder of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.5 feet wide across the base.
